Your 47% match makes this a WEAK FIT for the Cloudflare Egress role.

- 11 years of backend engineering, well past the 8+ requirement

- Led 4 engineers through a 9-month monolith-to-services migration

**Gaps:**
- No Go or Rust, both core languages for this role
- No Layer 3/4 networking, TLS, HTTP or CDN experience
- No Kubernetes, Linux networking or ClickHouse experience

**Recommendation:** Build a Go or Rust networking project covering TCP and TLS first, then apply with your distributed-systems leadership as the headline.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Cloudflare

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Egress team owns connectivity for products like WARP and the iCloud Private Relay egress proxy, where a slow or fragile path affects every product built on top. I've faced a similar problem at a smaller scale: the payment status API at Lumen Payments had a p99 latency of 480 ms, and I cut it to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis.

I'm a Senior Backend Engineer with 11 years of experience building payment and event-processing services. At Lumen I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka, and I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services. I was on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents, so a Run What You Build model is familiar ground. I haven't worked in Go or Rust professionally, and I won't pretend otherwise. What I bring is production-critical distributed systems experience, API design, code review and mentoring, and the habit of learning a stack quickly. I returned from a planned career break in 2025, and during it I earned my AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification.

I'd welcome a conversation about how this background could support the Egress team's work on distributed, high-availability systems. I'm available to start a discussion at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer - Egress, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Hello Cloudflare Egress team,

You're looking for someone to own production-critical distributed systems, and at Lumen Payments I designed and ran the settlement service on Kafka and led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services. I was also on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents, so I know how to debug and stabilise complex systems under pressure. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a call any weekday next week and can start a conversation at short notice.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

Kind regards,
